summary: Specifies a way for a SIP user agent client to send one MESSAGE request to many destinations, through a SIP URI-list service. The client sends the payload together with a list of URIs to the service, which sends a MESSAGE request with the payload to every URI in the list. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Rather than texting each friend one by one, you send one text and a list of names to a helper. The helper then delivers a copy to everyone on the list.

questions: send sip instant message to multiple uris
